summary: Resets a ring buffer's head and tail WORD indices (this + 0x1000 and this + 0x1002, element indices 2048 and 2049 of a _WORD array) to 0, marking the buffer empty, and returns 0. Unconditional; no early return. Called from AI/session paths (sub_57DE30, sub_57E570, SocketAddressInit).

operations.description: Set ring buffer head index at this + 0x1000 (this[2048] as WORD) to 0.
Set ring buffer tail index at this + 0x1002 (this[2049] as WORD) to 0.
Return 0 (result is initialized to 0 before the field writes).

unresolved: Owner object and buffer size are unknown; indices 2048/2049 are only known to be WORD fields at 0x1000/0x1002.
Relationship to the calling socket/AI session structures is unproven.
